sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS The net proceeds to us from this offering are estimated to be approximately $12.5 billion (or approximately $14.3 billion if the
underwriters exercise in full their over-allotment option to purchase additional Series A Depositary Shares from us), after deducting underwriting discounts and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering for general corporate purposes.
